title: 第1603章 神圣封禁第1602章 身化白金月
slug: 从鹰人进化为天使后我荡平诸神
lines: 无量白金光辉在这一方天地间瞬间绽放，这是比黄金大日还要灿烂的光芒。
一方神圣的天意再度撑开了山穹，宛若王者重临世间。
四方浊王的天意，顿时被这一神圣天意所挤开，攻杀向佛皇金蟾子的杀伐，也在一瞬间被圣光消融。
在金蟾子惊喜的眼神中，在佛国诸军震撼的视线里，在无尽浊世黑影恐惧的目光中，在四位浊王惊讶的神情中。
一道英姿伟岸的光辉身影从这轮升于天上的白金之月中踏出。
祂面容俊美无铸，银发张扬飘舞，持长剑而横推无敌！
那气势浩浩荡荡，无人可比拟，是镇压了一切敌人所养成的无敌之势！
“怎么祂又活了？”
“祂没有死？！”
“该死，祂是在假死！”
浊王们惊怒无比。
尤其是红世之主，青世之主，和黑世之主，他们的动作十分默契地往后回转，生怕被这尊“复活”而来的君王按杀当场！
他们为了攻杀佛皇金蟾子，离元始神山的大地太近了，姜尤只需要微微抬剑，便能够够到他们。
但下一刻。
他们便看到。
这位光辉万丈的身影并没有来找他们，而是一步横跨了时空的距离，瞬间出现在初世之王的身前，一手直接按在他的头顶。
“抓住你了！”
威严光辉的皇者淡然道。
下一秒。
无尽的伟力轰然绽放，无上的剑意铮铮作响！
一轮白金明月被祂高举，又狠狠砸落初王之身上。
这是抓住时机的全力出手，仿佛要把这位最古老尊贵的浊王，镇杀当场！
瞬间。
初世之王便被姜尤打落大地，狠狠砸在神山之上！
“该死，你在做什么！”
初世之王惊怒不已，他被打了个措手不及，但这样的攻击，却好像并没有对他造成伤害，只是暂时打断了他的动作。
故而。
姜尤并没有停下。
祂一步踏向大地，再次踩踏在初世之王的头颅上，将他压回大地上。
被人踩着头颅的屈辱让初世之王彻底暴怒了！
“该死，该死！”
“尤利尔，你竟敢如此对我！”
content_en:
Infinite platinum brilliance bloomed instantly in this area of ​​heaven and earth. This was a light even more brilliant than the golden sun.
The divine providence once again propped up the mountain dome, like a king returning to the world.
The providential will of the King of Sifang Zhuo was immediately squeezed out by this divine providential will, and the attack on the Buddha Emperor Jin Chanzi was also melted by the holy light in an instant.
In the surprised eyes of Jin Chanzi, in the shocked eyes of the Buddhist armies, in the frightened eyes of the endless black shadows in the troubled world, in the surprised expressions of the four troubled kings.
A majestic and glorious figure stepped out of the platinum moon rising in the sky.
His face is extremely handsome, his silver hair is fluttering, and he holds a long sword and is invincible!
The majestic momentum is unmatched by anyone. It is the invincible momentum developed by suppressing all enemies!
"Why is He alive again?"
"He's not dead?!"
"Damn it, He's faking death!"
The kings of Zhuo were shocked and angry.
Especially the Lord of the Red World, the Lord of the Green World, and the Lord of the Black World, they all turned back in unison, fearing that they would be killed on the spot by this "resurrected" king!
In order to attack the Buddha Emperor Jinchanzi, they were too close to the Yuanshi Holy Mountain. Jiang You only had to raise his sword slightly to reach them.
But the next moment.
Then they saw it.
This glorious figure did not come to them, but crossed the distance of time and space in one step and appeared in front of the first king in an instant, placing a hand directly on his head.
"Got you!"
The majestic and glorious emperor said calmly.
The next second.
Endless mighty power burst into bloom, and the supreme sword intent clanked!
A white gold moon was lifted high by Him, and then it crashed down on the First King.
This is an all-out attack that seizes the opportunity, as if to kill the most ancient and noble King Zhuo on the spot!
moment.
The first king was knocked off the ground by Jiang You and hit the sacred mountain hard!
"Damn, what are you doing!"
The First King was shocked and furious. He was caught off guard, but such an attack did not seem to harm him, but only temporarily interrupted his movements.
Therefore.
Jiang You didn't stop.
He stepped towards the earth, stepped on the head of the first king again, and pressed him back to the earth.
The humiliation of having his head stepped on made the first king completely furious!
"Damn, damn!"
"Uriel, how dare you do this to me!"
